'''Smothered''' is a [[debuff]] that applies less [[recovery]] rate of [[life]], [[mana]], and [[energy shield]]. 

==Mechanics and sources==
As a debuff to recovery ''rate'', Smothered only modifies over-time recovery. 

Smothered is applied on [[hit]] by [[Embezzler's Offer]] (a variant of [[Aurate Warrior]]s) and [[Embezzler's Own]] (a variant of [[Aurate Archer]]s), summoned by {{c|torment|[[Tormented Embezzler]]}} and by monsters affected by its {{c|torment|Touch}}. Embezzler's Offers apply the debuff with a value of 50% less, while Embezzler's Owns apply 100% less.
